initial_frame = history[0].frame

        c_min = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  color={n['color']} at ({r_min},{c_min})")

# Check player initial position
player = [n for n in initial_seg if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18]

    p = player[0]
    print(f"\nInitial player: rows {min(r[0] for r in p['boundary'])}-{max(r[0] for r in p['boundary'])}")

# Check initial bottom panel
print("\nInitial bottom panel:")
for n in initial_seg:
    if n['pixels'] == 16 and n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N']:
        r_min = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        if r_min >= 54:
            print(f"  color={n['color']} at col {c_min}")

        c_min = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  color={n['color']} at col {c_min}")
